Terms and Conditions of Use for NearHouse
By creating an account or using NearHouse, you accept these terms. We recommend reading them carefully. If you do not agree with anything, you may stop using the app at any time.

NearHouse is an app to publish and search for houses, apartments, and land for sale or rent in Manzanillo, Colima.
NearHouse is an academic project created by students. It is not a formal business or commercial service.
• It may contain errors or change over time.
• We may modify, suspend, or remove the app at any time.
• If you downloaded it without knowing about the project, please keep in mind that it is not a professional service and we do not guarantee it will always be available.

To create an account and use NearHouse, you must be at least 18 years old. By registering, you confirm that you meet this age requirement. If we detect that an account belongs to a minor, we will suspend it and delete its data.

• The information you provide when registering must be true.
• We verify your email and phone number.
• You can sign in with your email and password, or with your Google account.
• Take care of your password. You are responsible for anything done with your account.

Any user can report a listing. Administrators review reports and can remove listings, suspend, or delete accounts that do not comply with these rules.\nIf you want to delete your account, request it at [CORREO DE CONTACTO]. We will delete your data within 30 days.

NearHouse only connects the publisher with the seeker. We are not party to the sale or rental, we do not charge a commission for them, and we do not guarantee that what is published is accurate.\nInspect the property and its documents before paying or signing anything.

Payments to publish or promote a listing, and to subscribe to a plan, are simulated. NearHouse makes no real charges to your card or bank account.\n• We recommend not entering real card details.\n• Since there are no real charges, there are no refunds.
NearHouse is not liable for fraud between users, nor for damages or issues resulting from an agreement between them or the use of the app.
• The photos and text of your listings remain yours.\n• By publishing them, you allow NearHouse to display them within the app.\n• We can remove any content that violates these rules.
If we change these terms, we will notify you within the app 15 days in advance. If you continue using NearHouse after that period, you accept the changes.
If you have questions about these terms, write to us at [CORREO DE CONTACTO].

Welcome to NearHouse. This Privacy Notice applies to the NearHouse application and its related services (the \"Platform\"), developed as an academic project.\n\nWe are committed to protecting your privacy. This notice explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal information within the app, pursuant to the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties. If you do not agree with this notice, we recommend not using the Platform.
Who is responsible for your data
The entity responsible for your personal data is [NOMBRE DEL RESPONSABLE], located at [CIUDAD O DOMICILIO]. You can contact us at [CORREO DE CONTACTO].
What each piece of data is used for

• Full name: to identify you and show who posted a listing.
• Email: to verify your account, recover it if you forget your password, and allow other users to contact you when you publish.
• Phone number: to verify your account via SMS, recover it, and allow other users to contact you via WhatsApp when you publish.
• Password: so you can log in.
• Google name and email: to create your account and allow you to log in without entering a password.
• Date of birth: to confirm you are at least 18 years old.
• Profile photo: to display it on your account.
• Property photos: to display your listing.
• Location when taking photos: to verify they were taken at the property and show it on the map.
• Location when using the map: to show you nearby properties.
• Property address: to indicate where it is located.
• Saved listings: so you can easily find what interests you.

We do not sell your data. We only use third-party services for the app to function:
• Google Firebase: phone verification via SMS and Google sign-in.
• Google Maps: displaying the map.
• Railway: servers where data is stored. They may be located outside Mexico.
• Brevo: sending emails with your verification code.

• Your password is saved encrypted. No one can see it, not even the NearHouse team.\n• Access to data is limited.\n• We keep your data while your account is active, and for 30 days after you request account deletion.

You have the right to:
• Access: know what data we hold about you.
• Rectification: correct or update your data.
• Cancellation: request that we delete your data.
• Opposition: request that a specific piece of data not be used for a specific purpose.

How to exercise them: write to us at [CORREO DE CONTACTO] with your full name, your account email, and your request.

Response time: we will respond within a maximum period of 20 business days.

Withdraw consent: you can also withdraw your consent at any time through the same channel.

If you believe we did not handle your request properly, you may contact the Ministry of Anti-Corruption and Good Governance (Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Governance).
NearHouse is intended only for people over 18 years old. We do not intentionally collect data from minors. If we detect an account belonging to a minor, we will delete it.
If we change this notice, we will notify you within the app and update the \"Last updated\" date shown above.
